scope: Broaden the DWG/DXF implementation review to an active browser CAD consumer and re-evaluate the current ezdwg graph API as an optional common-2D observation, without adding a peer gate or slowing local implementation.

method.kind: Primary-source repository, architecture, FAQ, and API documentation review plus local plan cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: Documentation establishes declared route composition and API shape only. No package/source identity was executed, no drawing was read, no 3D rendering or geometry was reproduced, and no complete source-lineage audit was performed for the built-in DXF parser.

evidence.topic: CAD-Viewer's open-source DWG path is LibreDWG lineage, not a second parser
observed: The CAD-Viewer README states that DWG loading is opt-in and uses the @mlightcad/libredwg-converter package when a host registers it.
The converter documentation says it loads LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly in a worker and maps data into the @mlightcad/data-model.
The libredwg-web repository identifies itself as a JavaScript parser based on LibreDWG.
doesNotEstablish: An independent DWG parser implementation or a distinct DWG semantic vote.
Complete DWG object-graph preservation, ACIS/AcDs closure, or native CAD acceptance.
Behavior of a specific package/runtime because no artifact was pinned or executed.
evidence.planUse: Correlate CAD-Viewer DWG results under the LibreDWG lineage. Treat a future viewer run as an optional application/projection observation only, never as a second parser vote.

evidence.topic: CAD-Viewer public descriptions do not qualify 3D DWG support
observed: The architecture overview describes a Three.js renderer and broad 2D/3D visualization language.
The project FAQ says the current viewer focuses on 2D and that 3D DWG viewing is planned.
The separate proprietary-parser page states that ACIS/SAB extraction is partial and that current display falls back to a best-effort wireframe or bounding box rather than full B-rep tessellation.
doesNotEstablish: 3D entity or solid support in the open-source LibreDWG path.
Topology, solid validity, analytic geometry, or ACIS semantic correctness.
A current commercial route available or authorized for this repository's qualification.
evidence.planUse: Do not infer 3D support from renderer architecture, screenshots, entity recognition, wireframe, or bounds. Keep parser delivery, projection, and B-rep semantic evidence as separate tiers.

evidence.topic: CAD-Viewer DXF package does not yet establish an independent parser lineage
observed: The README describes a built-in MIT DXF parser in @mlightcad/data-model; the architecture overview also names @mlightcad/dxf-json.
The architecture overview says the DXF parser is based on existing open-source code but does not identify a complete source-to-package lineage in that page.
doesNotEstablish: Whether the published package is independent of other already-reviewed DXF parser lineages.
A declared version/encoding matrix, 3D semantics, or writer support.
Runtime behavior or parity with libdxfrw.
evidence.planUse: Keep it as an unaudited optional DXF model/projection candidate. Do not count it as an independent peer until exact package/source identity and parser lineage are reviewed.

evidence.topic: ezdwg Document.graph adds an optional higher-level graph observation, not a lossless graph oracle
observed: The API describes graph nodes, common entity data, object edges, layer rows, block-header rows, and inferred model/paper-space header handles.
The raw API separately exposes the Rust decode functions.
The changelog describes version- and entity-specific native decoding and paired-DXF regressions.
doesNotEstablish: Exact original object-table or owner-map coverage from inferred space handles and a high-level IR.
Coverage outside the explicitly implemented version/entity subset.
Independent DXF writer evidence from ezdwg.to_dxf(), which is documented as using ezdxf.
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed checkpoint only, optionally compare raw-decoder fields and graph observations as distinct result layers against an independent source-authored manifest. Record exact artifact/source identity, version, owner/layout inference, skipped types, and diagnostics. Do not add a dependency, fixture, or routine peer run.

ownersRefined: Optional ezdwg common-2D DWG differential and graph observation
Consumer projection versus 3D semantic evidence boundary
